newsitem.title: USA: Complaint filed vs Bell Atlantic-NYNEX venture.
newsitem.headline: Complaint filed vs Bell Atlantic-NYNEX venture.

text.p: Cellexis International Inc said Friday it lodged a complaint with regulators against Bell Atlantic Corp and NYNEX Corp's joint cellular venture, accusing it of trying to unfairly eliminate competition.
The company also asked the Federal Communications Commission to bar Bell Atlantic-NYNEX mobile from disconnecting Cellexis from the cellular network.

Cellexis is a Tempe, Az-based provider of prepaid cellular service at 49 cents a minute. The company said its switch must be "interconnected" to the Bell Atlantic-NYNEX Mobile network to provide service.
It accused Bell Atlantic-NYNEX mobile of trying to eliminate competition while the joint venture sets up its own competing prepaid cellular service at $1 a minute.
Cellexis charged that termination of its interconnection agreement with the joint venture would be discriminatory and illegal under the new communications act.

"Bell Atlantic-NYNEX Mobile cannot succeed in selling its own prepaid service at $1 per minute unless it eliminates competition from Cellexis at 49 cents per minute" Cellexis President Douglas Fougnies said in a statement.
